summary: nCino, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting Q2 FY2027 results and announcing a board-authorized stock repurchase program of up to $100 million of common stock. Repurchases may occur via open market, block trades, private negotiations, accelerated stock repurchase, or Rule 10b5-1 plans. The program has no time limit, does not obligate repurchases, and can be modified or suspended at board discretion. This is a capital return event, not a tender offer, with no fixed price per share or premium.
